name: deals.public.launch_intent
summary:
OpenYC front door — anonymous "intent → launch" in ONE call. Mints a
temporary owner (so the deal has a creator membership and the launch has
a user context), builds the deal via the SAME path as define()
(classification + slot resolution + public-channel activation), and mints
the F3 compute-deposit PaymentIntent. The visitor confirms the returned
client_secret with Stripe; payment_intent.succeeded → the global webhook
→ DealLaunchJob → the agt orchestrator starts the program

name: deals.wizard.codify
summary:
Step 2 — solution generation. Calls OpenAI (HTTP-fakeable in
tests) to produce 3 solutions, stakeholders[], and a financing
envelope. Persists everything on the Deal. Does NOT advance the
state machine — the deal is already in `codified` after the
required-info call. Per DEAL_RUNTIME/06_WIZARD_INTEGRATION.md §66-148

name: deals.wizard.compute_deposit
summary:
Compute deposit — mint a Stripe PaymentIntent funding the 5-tier
deposit (pink $1, green $10, blue $100, red $1,000, black $10,000)
for this deal and persist a `pending` DealComputeDeposit row keyed
by the PI id. The webhook handler (ProgramSaleController →
ProgramPurchase::handleProgramPurchase) flips it to `succeeded` and
dispatches DealLaunchJob on payment_intent.succeeded

name: deals.wizard.details

name: deals.wizard.files.destroy

the Dropzone preview on step 4 (or removes the logo on step 2),

orphan. Idempotent — returns 404 if the file doesn't exist, 204
on a successful delete or a no-op

name: deals.wizard.required_info
summary:
Step 1 continuation — citizen submits answers to the required_info
questions the OWL reasoner produced at define time. Validates every
declared key is answered, persists answers on `problem.answers`,
and advances the state machine analyzing → codified via the
orchestrator. Per DEAL_RUNTIME/06_WIZARD_INTEGRATION.md §32-64

name: deals.wizard.select_solution
summary:
Step 2 user action — pick one of the 3 generated solutions.
Sets selected_solution_idx; does NOT advance state. Per
DEAL_RUNTIME/06_WIZARD_INTEGRATION.md §81-84

name: deals.wizard.setup
summary:
Step 3 — materialize pipeline_steps + DealStepAssignment rows,
advance state codified → setup. Per
DEAL_RUNTIME/06_WIZARD_INTEGRATION.md §168-212

name: deals.wizard.start
summary:
Step 3 → 4 transition — citizen confirms ready to execute. State
machine setup → executing. Per
DEAL_RUNTIME/06_WIZARD_INTEGRATION.md §185

name: deals.wizard.submit
summary:
Step 5 of the intake wizard — submit. Validates that all four
prior intake steps recorded their data, then advances the deal
analyzing → `awaiting_compute` through the orchestrator's state
machine (#1412 0.1 — previously a raw off-enum write). Downstream
`agt/` handlers pick the deal up from that state once a Compute
deposit lands via Stripe webhook (see ComputeController::topupIntent
+ ProgramSaleController::handleWebhook → DealOrchestrator::launchDeal)
